sky.qualification: Earth's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.

provenance.source: Google Earth Pro Mars native Sun contract-derived visual standard
provenance.qualification: The Mars-derived Sun direction and camera-relative motion are shared as a cssEarth presentation standard; no per-object native Sun position or ephemeris is claimed.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.legendNote: 0 = mean sea level. Shading emphasizes relief; the color scale is unshaded. Some coastal source datums differ.

controls.label: Night lights
controls.legendNote: Logarithmic color scale, capped at 100 nW/cm²/sr. Native pixels are averaged for this globe. Aurora and transient lights can remain; this does not measure sky brightness.

controls.label: ENSO
controls.legendNote: NASA imagery uses 0.1 °C color bins; the NOAA advisory describes the coupled ocean–atmosphere state.

controls.label: Mantle tomography
controls.legendNote: GLAD-M35 r0.1 · 10–2,890 km depth · 1° / 10 km sample grid. Gray: outside model depth coverage. Grid spacing is not resolving power.
